Iris Park: Heads-up — ran into a weird failure mode in the Python quickstart. The demo used the new `auto_idempotency` experiment and we still ended up with duplicated creates. Repro below.
Noah Becker: Interesting. Was the SDK generating a key or deriving it from the payload?
Iris Park: Our internal experiment tried to be clever: generate an idempotency key by hashing the JSON payload so users don't have to pass a key. Code path: `if auto_idempotency and not idempotency_key: idempotency_key = sha256(json.dumps(body).encode()).hex()`
Sam Torres: Ohhhh. That can be brittle. If the serialization order changes or there are transient fields like `created_at` timestamps, the hash will differ on retry. That produces a new key and defeats dedupe.
Iris Park: Exactly. Logs: ```
2026-04-01T14:03:10Z WARN req=foo123 status=408 read_timeout
2026-04-01T14:03:11Z INFO retrying req=foo123 attempt=2 backoff=0.5s
2026-04-01T14:03:12Z INFO request=req=bar456 status=201 created=item-900
```
Noah Becker: So first attempt probably timed out but server may have processed it; retry had a different derived key -> server created a second item. Yikes.
Sam Torres: Two problems here: (1) payload-derived keys are non-obvious and can leak structure of payload (privacy concern), (2) non-determinism in serialization breaks dedupe.
Iris Park: Customers hit this in a demo; we should roll back the payload-hash auto-key experiment. Quick wins: update quickstart to explicitly show `idempotency_key=str(uuid.uuid4())`, and change SDK to only auto-generate UUIDs (not payload hashes).
Noah Becker: Agreed. Also add a warning in docs about deterministic serialization if people try to implement their own payload-hash keys. Recommend canonical JSON with sorted keys when hashing (but still warn about timestamps or volatile fields).
Sam Torres: For typing: our stubs currently allow `idempotency_key: str | None` but a couple of customer snippets passed bytes or ints and headers failed at runtime. Suggest enforcing `idempotency_key: Optional[str]` in stubs and adding a small runtime validation that raises a ValueError early if not str. Also add a mypy check in CI for the example snippets.
Iris Park: Good call. Also need tests for the regression: unit test that simulates 408 then 200 with auto-idempotency using payload-hash vs uuid and assert duplicates happen only for payload-hash. CI observed this: `ci-bot` run 2222223344 captured a failing integration test reproducing duplicate-create when `auto_idempotency=hash_payload`.
doc-bot: Note created: INF-7811 "Disable payload-hash auto-idempotency; prefer uuid generation; docs + quickstart updates".
Noah Becker: API decision: keep `auto_idempotency` flag but change semantics: `auto_idempotency='uuid'` (default) or `auto_idempotency='payload-hash'` (explicit, opt-in and discouraged). Type: `Literal['off','uuid','payload-hash']` with default `'off'` for backwards compat. That makes behavior explicit in signature.
Sam Torres: If we expose `'payload-hash'` we must document privacy and determinism caveats and include an example canonicalization: `json.dumps(body, separators=(',', ':'), sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)`. Also add a strong warning: "Do not include PII in payload-hash keys."
Iris Park: For quickstart we'll show `auto_idempotency='uuid'` in the demo snippet so new users are protected and keep it explicit. We'll make the payload-hash option hidden in advanced docs.
Noah Becker: Tests to add: unit + integration mocks: (1) auto='uuid' ensures single create after 408/200, (2) auto='payload-hash' with transient timestamp field shows duplicate create, (3) idempotency_key passed as non-str raises ValueError, (4) header preserved during auth refresh (previous bug).
Sam Torres: Backoff note: docs should keep recommending `decorrelated_jitter` and `max_retries=3`. Also call out that `retry_on` list should include 408 and relevant 5xx but that these are "uncertain" and idempotency is required for write ops.
ci-bot: CI run 2222223344: integration/quickstart duplicated-create reproduced with `auto_idempotency=payload-hash`.
Iris Park: I'll open a PR to revert the hash auto-key path and update quickstart. Noah, can you update the type stubs and runtime validation? Sam, please add tests.
Noah Becker: On it. Will change function sig to `auto_idempotency: Literal['off','uuid','payload-hash'] = 'off'` and add runtime guard.
Sam Torres: I'll add the tests and an integration job that runs quickstart example under flaky network simulator.
Iris Park: Thanks team — prioritize for the minor patch release this week. Will notify the demo owner and the customer. :thumbsup:
